# Section Hover/Selection Highlighting on Map

## Problem
When users hover or select a section in the Sections panel, nothing happens on the map. Users expect to see all shots and stations belonging to that section highlighted on the map, similar to how individual shots/stations highlight when hovered on the map.

Additionally, the interaction should be bidirectional: hovering shots/stations on the map should highlight the corresponding section row in the Sections panel.

## Approach

### State Management (uiStore)
Add `hoveredSectionId: SectionId | null` to uiStore with `setHoveredSectionId` action at lines 183-186 (alongside existing `hoveredStation`, `hoveredShot`).

**Key files:**
- `src/store/uiStore.ts:183-186` - existing hover state pattern
- `src/store/uiStore.ts:450-453` - hover setter implementation

### SurveyLayer API
Add methods following existing patterns at lines 583-598:
- `setHoveredSection(sectionId: SectionId | null)`
- `setSelectedSection(sectionId: SectionId | null)`

**Key files:**
- `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx:56-61` - visual state tracking
- `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx:583-598` - setter methods pattern

### MapLibre Expression Builder
Create `src/utils/maplibre-expressions.ts` with pure function:
```typescript
buildPriorityExpression(priorities: {condition: Expression, value: any}[], fallback: any): Expression
```

**CRITICAL: sectionId type handling**
Features store `sectionId` as **number** (see line 733, 759, 782). The expression must use `['to-string', ['get', 'sectionId']]` to convert for string comparison (see existing pattern at line 535).

### Visual Priority Order (highest to lowest)
1. Snap (4px stroke, #00ffcc)
2. Individual hover (3px stroke, #0066ff)
3. **Section hover (3px stroke, #0066ff)** - NEW
4. Individual selected (2px stroke, #00aaff)
5. **Section selected (2px stroke, #00aaff)** - NEW
6. Normal (1px stroke, #000000)

### Sections Panel Changes
**Key file:** `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx:68-108`

- Add `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` handlers to section rows
- Add keyboard accessibility: `role="listbox"`, rows as `role="option"`
- Arrow key navigation with DOM focus movement
- `onFocus` triggers same hover highlight as mouse
- Enter/Space to select, Escape to clear
- `data-testid="section-row-{id}"` for E2E testing
- Use template literals for conditional classes (no `cn()` utility exists)

**Fix for blur-on-click flash:** Use `onMouseDown` for selection instead of `onClick` to fire before `onBlur`.

### MapCanvas Integration
**Key file:** `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:584-597` - selection sync pattern

Extend existing selection sync effect to handle section type.
Add new effect for hover sync from uiStore to SurveyLayer.

### Bidirectional Sync (Map → Panel)
Derive `hoveredSectionId` from existing hover callbacks in `useMapTools`:
- `handleStationHover`: StationRef has `section_id` property
- `handleShotHover`: shot has `sectionId` property

## Edge Cases
- Empty sections (no shots): Still interactive, just no map highlight
- Virtual shots: Include in highlight (same visual treatment as real shots)
- Merged stations: Only highlight stations belonging to hovered section, not merge partners
- Loop closures: Don't highlight with section hover (separate visualization)
- Merge connection lines: No change on section hover
- Hover overrides selection: When different section is hovered while one is selected, hover visuals take precedence
- Same section hovered+selected: Hover appearance (consistent with priority rule)
- Zero-datum stations: Gold stroke preserved (expression builder handles priority)
- Rapid hover transitions: No debounce needed - React/MapLibre handle updates efficiently

## File References
| File | Lines | Purpose |
|------|-------|---------|
| `src/store/uiStore.ts` | 183-186, 450-453 | Hover state pattern |
| `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx` | 56-61, 532-580, 583-598 | Visual state, expressions, setters |
| `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx` | 584-597, 599-603 | Selection/hover sync effects |
| `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx` | 68-108 | Section list rendering |
| `src/hooks/useMapTools.ts` | 299-312 | Hover callback pattern |

## Quick commands
```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run unit tests (includes expression builder tests)
pnpm test

# Run Playwright E2E tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
```

## Acceptance
- [ ] Hovering section row in panel highlights all shots/stations on map (simultaneous)
- [ ] Clicking section row in panel selects and highlights all shots/stations on map
- [ ] Hovering shot/station on map highlights corresponding section row in panel
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works: Tab into panel, arrow keys between rows, Enter to select
- [ ] Focus on row triggers map highlight (same as mouse hover)
- [ ] Escape clears selection
- [ ] Visual priority: snap > individual hover > section hover > individual selected > section selected > normal
- [ ] Labels unchanged on section hover (matching existing shot/station hover behavior)
- [ ] No pan/zoom on hover - only visual highlight
- [ ] Works in SingleSystemView only (where Sections panel exists)
- [ ] Unit tests for expression builder at `src/utils/maplibre-expressions.test.ts`
- [ ] Playwright E2E tests at `e2e-playwright/section-highlighting.spec.ts`
- [ ] WebdriverIO tests for accessibility + visual behavior
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-9-d6v.3 Add section hover/selection methods to SurveyLayer

## Description
Add section hover/selection methods to SurveyLayer following existing patterns.

## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

**Add private state (near L56-61 where other hover/selection state is):**
```typescript
private hoveredSectionId: string | null = null;
private selectedSectionId: string | null = null;
```

**Add public methods (near L141-160 where other setters are):**
```typescript
/**
 * Set the hovered section for visual highlighting.
 * All shots and stations in this section will show hover styling.
 */
setHoveredSection(sectionId: string | null): void {
  if (this.hoveredSectionId === sectionId) return;
  this.hoveredSectionId = sectionId;
  this.updateVisualState();
}

/**
 * Set the selected section for visual highlighting.
 * All shots and stations in this section will show selected styling.
 */
setSelectedSection(sectionId: string | null): void {
  if (this.selectedSectionId === sectionId) return;
  this.selectedSectionId = sectionId;
  this.updateVisualState();
}
```

## Why This Pattern
- Matches existing `setSelectedStation`, `setSelectedShot`, `setHoveredStation` pattern
- Early return optimization if ID hasn't changed
- Automatically triggers `updateVisualState()` to refresh MapLibre paint properties
## Acceptance
- [ ] `hoveredSectionId: string | null` private state added
- [ ] `selectedSectionId: string | null` private state added
- [ ] `setHoveredSection(sectionId)` public method added
- [ ] `setSelectedSection(sectionId)` public method added
- [ ] Both methods call `updateVisualState()` on change
- [ ] Both methods have early return if ID unchanged
- [ ] Methods follow existing naming/style patterns
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-9-d6v.4 Update SurveyLayer.updateVisualState for section highlighting

## Description
Update SurveyLayer.updateVisualState() to include section-level highlighting.

## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

**Import expression builder at top:**
```typescript
import { buildPriorityExpression, compositeIdEquals, inSection } from '../../utils/maplibre-expressions';
```

**Refactor updateVisualState() (L532-580):**

**Priority order for stations (circle-stroke-width):**
1. snap: 4px
2. individual hover: 3px  
3. **section hover: 3px** (NEW)
4. individual selected: 2px
5. **section selected: 2px** (NEW)
6. normal: 1px

**Implementation using expression builder:**
```typescript
private updateVisualState() {
  // Station stroke width with section-level priorities
  const stationStrokeWidth = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.snappedStationId), value: 4 },
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.hoveredStationId), value: 3 },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: 3 },  // NEW
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.selectedStationId), value: 2 },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: 2 },  // NEW
  ], 1);
  
  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'circle-stroke-width', stationStrokeWidth);

  // Station stroke color (same priority order)
  const stationStrokeColor = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.snappedStationId), value: '#00ffcc' },
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.selectedStationId), value: '#00aaff' },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: '#00aaff' },  // NEW
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'stationIndex'], this.hoveredStationId), value: '#0066ff' },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: '#0066ff' },  // NEW
  ], ['get', 'strokeColor']);  // Fallback preserves zero-datum gold

  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'circle-stroke-color', stationStrokeColor);

  // Shot line width with section priorities
  const shotLineWidth = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'shotId'], this.hoveredShotId), value: 4 },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: 4 },  // NEW
    { condition: compositeIdEquals(['sectionId', 'shotId'], this.selectedShotId), value: 3 },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: 3 },  // NEW
  ], 2);

  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.shotsLayerId, 'line-width', shotLineWidth);
}
```

## Key Points
- **inSection() handles type conversion**: sectionId stored as number, converted to string
- **compositeIdEquals() replaces inline expressions**: Cleaner, testable code
- **Zero-datum gold stroke preserved**: Fallback uses `['get', 'strokeColor']`
- **Virtual shots included**: They have sectionId, so inSection() matches them
## Files to Modify

### `src/components/Map/SurveyLayer.tsx`

**Refactor updateVisualState() (L533-579) to use expression builder:**

Import at top:
```typescript
import { buildPriorityExpression, featureEquals, inSection } from '@/utils/maplibre-expressions';
```

**Priority order for stations (circle-stroke-width):**
1. snap: 4px
2. individual hover: 3px  
3. **section hover: 3px** (NEW)
4. individual selected: 2px
5. **section selected: 2px** (NEW)
6. normal: 1px

**Implementation:**
```typescript
private updateVisualState() {
  const stationIdExpr = ['concat', ['get', 'sectionId'], ':', ['to-string', ['get', 'stationIndex']]];

  // Station stroke width with section-level priorities
  const stationStrokeWidth = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.snappedStationId ?? ''], value: 4 },
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.hoveredStationId ?? ''], value: 3 },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: 3 },
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.selectedStationId ?? ''], value: 2 },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: 2 },
  ], 1);
  
  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'circle-stroke-width', stationStrokeWidth);

  // Station stroke color (same priority order)
  const stationStrokeColor = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.snappedStationId ?? ''], value: '#00ffcc' },
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.selectedStationId ?? ''], value: '#00aaff' },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: '#00aaff' },
    { condition: ['==', stationIdExpr, this.hoveredStationId ?? ''], value: '#0066ff' },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: '#0066ff' },
  ], ['get', 'strokeColor']);

  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.stationsLayerId, 'circle-stroke-color', stationStrokeColor);

  // Shot line width with section priorities
  const shotIdExpr = ['concat', ['get', 'sectionId'], ':', ['get', 'shotId']];
  const shotLineWidth = buildPriorityExpression([
    { condition: ['==', shotIdExpr, this.hoveredShotId ?? ''], value: 4 },
    { condition: inSection(this.hoveredSectionId), value: 4 },
    { condition: ['==', shotIdExpr, this.selectedShotId ?? ''], value: 3 },
    { condition: inSection(this.selectedSectionId), value: 3 },
  ], 2);

  this.map.setPaintProperty(this.shotsLayerId, 'line-width', shotLineWidth);
}
```

## Visual Treatment
- Section hover/selection uses SAME visual style as individual hover/selection
- All shots AND stations in section highlight simultaneously
- Virtual shots included (they have same sectionId)
- Merge lines and loop closures NOT affected (separate layers)
## Acceptance
- [ ] Expression builder imported from `../../utils/maplibre-expressions`
- [ ] `compositeIdEquals()` replaces inline station/shot ID expressions
- [ ] `inSection()` used for section-level matching (handles number→string conversion)
- [ ] Station stroke-width includes section hover (3px) and section selected (2px)
- [ ] Station stroke-color includes section hover (#0066ff) and section selected (#00aaff)
- [ ] Station stroke-color fallback uses `['get', 'strokeColor']` (preserves zero-datum gold)
- [ ] Shot line-width includes section hover (4px) and section selected (3px)
- [ ] Priority order: snap > individual hover > section hover > individual selected > section selected > normal
- [ ] Virtual shots highlight (inSection matches their sectionId)
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
